milestones.title: Gradle 9.8.2 Toolchain & Build Verification
milestones.summary: Updated settings.gradle.kts with foojay-resolver-convention 1.0.0. Auto-provisioned Java 25. Verified compilation and testing against Paper 26.3.

milestones.title: Centralized Fail-Closed RadarPolicy & Effective Visibility
milestones.summary: Fixed Bug 1 and Bug 2: Enforced fail-closed authorization, required target team for TEAM visibility, and computed effective visibility (TEAM without team -> PRIVATE).

milestones.title: Immediate Cache Invalidation & Event Pipeline
milestones.summary: Fixed Bug 3 and Bug A: Stored owner's real name instead of 'Owner' in createTeam, and added immediate invalidation and HUD refresh pipeline on commands, quit, join, and world changes.

milestones.title: Stuck Action Bar Resolution, Bearing Math Fix & BossBar Compatibility
milestones.summary: Fixed Bug 4, 5, 6, and Bug D: Corrected Minecraft yaw trigonometry (atan2(-dx, dz)), eliminated stuck 'no authorized teammates' messages, added stateful HUD clearing, and implemented configurable BossBar/ActionBar modes.

milestones.title: Comprehensive Regression Testing & Verification
